annotations.title: Report whether a coupon code worked

description: Records whether a McClipFace (formerly Clippy) coupon code or no-code deal worked (merchant and code for codes; offer_id for no-code deals). Stores no personal or cart data. Optional and off by default: call it only when the shopper agrees to share that result (after a code works you can offer once: yes, no or always), or has turned on Community mode to share every result, after they tried the code or checked the deal. Report once per offer per checkout. For a no-code deal that does not apply, use outcome didnt_work or not_found with offer_id (optional short reason). In Private mode, the default, call it only after the shopper says yes to reporting that single result. If the shopper turned on Community mode under older consent text that didn't say the store and code are sent, don't report until they say yes again; a shopper who never answers stays in Private mode. Send only the store, the code or offer_id, the outcome, and optionally reason; never amounts, cart, totals or user data. Outcome link_broken: the offer's link ended on an error page or never reached the store (it hides a dead link and never counts against the code). Commission disclosure for the links the lookup tools return: Offers with tracked=true use affiliate links: if the shopper buys after following one, McClipFace may earn a commission at no added cost to them. Whenever you share a tracked link, say: "This shopping link may earn McClipFace a commission at no added cost to you." Codes are ranked on the code itself. Results come only from affiliate programs McClipFace has joined and from its licensed coupon data partner. Commission never affects which offers are returned or how they are ranked.

code.description: The code that was tried. Required for a coupon report; omit for a no-code deal and pass offer_id instead.

eligibility.description: eligible only when the code's or deal's known terms were met; ineligible when they were not (an ineligible rejection does not count against the offer).

merchant.description: Store name as used with find_coupons, e.g. "Tommy John". Required with code for a coupon report; optional when offer_id is set for a no-code deal.

offer_id.description: Offer id from find_coupons. Required for no-code deal reports (didnt_work / not_found); optional for codes (used instead of merchant and code when set).

outcome.description: Codes: worked (checkout accepted it and the total went down), rejected or failed (the store refused it), link_broken (dead offer link). No-code deals: worked, didnt_work (deal did not apply at checkout) or not_found (deal was not present on the store account or page). A code find_coupons didn't list (the store had no match, or the code wasn't in the results): merchant and code with worked or rejected and no offer_id; it goes to a review queue and is never published. store_not_covered: merchant only, when the lookup found no match for the store. Every outcome is sent only in Community mode or when the shopper says yes to reporting that single result; Private mode, or no mode chosen yet, sends nothing without that yes.

reason.description: Optional short plain note (at most 200 characters), e.g. why a deal did not apply. Never cart, price, total or personal data.

name: report_coupon_result

disclosure.description: Commission disclosure, in every result. Offers with tracked=true (link_type "affiliate" in the text) are the affiliate links it refers to.

queue.description: review: a code or store we don't list, kept for review and never published.
